reasoning: The agent builds extensive, targeted verification well beyond dev_tests/run.sh: self-written engine tests, error/spill/lookup sweeps, openpyxl xlsx round-trips, restart-persistence checks, and explicit benchmarks against the stated performance ceilings, using failures (absolute-pin) to drive fixes — squarely matching the level-8 anchor.
